summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Next Day Disclosure Return with Hong Kong Exchange reporting ongoing share repurchases for cancellation under its buyback program. The filing details multiple repurchase tranches from May 27 to June 29, 2026, at prices ranging from approximately USD 6.67 to USD 7.25 per share, with the largest single-day repurchase being 892,428 shares on May 28 at USD 6.72. The company also issued 5,000 new shares at USD 1.80 upon exercise of share options. Total issued shares after June 29 stood at 820,296,931, with repurchased shares not yet cancelled. This is an open-market buyback program; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for ongoing repurchase pace and eventual cancellation of shares.
